concerns.text: Tasks T018, T031, and T037 introduce 'Motif Participation Profiles' (3-node/4-node motifs) as predictors and visualizations. The spec (FR-001, US-1) and plan (Constraints) explicitly limit the predictor set to 'degree distribution, clustering coefficient, and average path length'. This constitutes a silent relaxation of the scope constraint and a violation of the 'No Synthetic Data/No Unauthorized Features' principle in the plan.

Task T014 specifies implementing a 'K sweep [0, 5] step 0.1'. The spec (FR-002 context) and plan (Complexity Tracking) explicitly mandate 'bisection search' to minimize quantization error. Implementing a discrete sweep as described in T014 fails to satisfy the precision requirement of the spec, effectively weakening the FR-002 deliverable.

Task T005 instructs the system to 'block regression downstream' if N < 10. Spec FR-004 explicitly requires that if N < 10, the system 'MUST output descriptive statistics... rather than attempting the fit'. Blocking the pipeline entirely prevents the generation of the required descriptive statistics, violating the fallback behavior mandated by the spec.

Task T017b implements an automated script to generate a verification report. Spec SC-003 requires 'manual verification' of the order parameter condition on the first 5 networks. Automating the check without a mechanism for human sign-off or recording the manual step violates the 'measurable outcome' definition of SC-003.

Tasks T028a and T028b split the cross-validation logic (LOOCV vs 10-fold) into two separate implementation tasks. Spec FR-005 defines this as a single conditional requirement ('IF... THEN...'). Splitting this creates a risk of inconsistent implementation and violates the principle of implementing the spec's conditional logic as a cohesive unit, potentially leading to a fragmented deliverable that fails the atomicity of the FR.
